title: PPG-MS3 — Ultimate Wire EDM Master Post (Fusion has no WEDM CPS)
description: Builds the WEDM master post that Fusion 360 does not provide. Covers 5 controller dialects (Mitsubishi M700V/M800, Sodick MotionLink, AgieCharmilles CC100/CT, Makino, Fanuc 31i WEDM) with full multi-pass skim schedule, taper compensation, wire tension/flush per-pass, thermal recast prediction, and corner overcut compensation. Inherits the sidecar bridge from PPG-MS0.
rationale: JM Die's Mitsubishi MV1200R is the highest-margin machine in the shop, and the existing PPG-WIRE-MS0 wired the engine to MCP — but the engine itself was a 1-pass placeholder. Real production WEDM needs 4-6 skim passes with pass-specific energy, wire tension, flush pressure, and offset table. No CAM vendor (Fusion, Mastercam, hyperMILL) ships a usable WEDM post for the M800. PRISM owns this gap.
leverage_existing: MitsubishiMV1200RWireEDMMasterPostEngine — basic engine wired in PPG-WIRE-MS0/U-PPGW03 (26 tests). PPG-MS3 EXTENDS it to full multi-pass schedule rather than re-implementing.

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: JM Die D2 fastener die, 12 mm thick, 4° taper, 0.25 mm corner radius. Mitsubishi MV1200R.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms3: Programmer hand-codes the skim schedule from a paper schedule sheet. Forgets to derate flush pressure on skim 4 → wire breaks twice on the corner → 90 min lost.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms3: Wizard generates 5-pass skim (rough → 4 skims) with pass-specific E (energy), TON, TOFF, IP, wire tension, flush. Corner overcut compensated (predicted 8 µm, programmed offset adjusts). Recast layer predicted ≤2 µm. Wire-break probability <0.5% per pass. Cuts first try, finishes spec.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: Highest-margin JM Die machine has a production-grade post that no CAM vendor ships.

units.title: Lift WEDMLatticeGraph + ProtoMAML + GraphAttention to generic PrismLattice* (consumed by PPG-MS9)
units.scope: Extract reusable lattice infrastructure into src/engines/PrismLatticeGraphEngine.ts + PrismPrototypicalNetworkEngine.ts + PrismGraphAttentionEngine.ts; WEDM versions become thin wrappers; PPG-MS9 ProtoMAML wiring consumes the generic layer instead of WEDM-specific. Variability sweep: ≥3 reference materials exercising the generic layer (D2 hard die, 4140 prehard, 17-4PH stainless) × ≥3 operations (multi-pass skim, taper, thin-wire <0.1mm) × ≥3 dialects (Mitsubishi M800, Sodick MotionLink, AgieCharmilles). Adversarial: (a) empty embedding query — must return canonical fallback; (b) circular cross-reference in lattice — must detect cycle and fail closed; (c) ProtoMAML transfer source = nearest-neighbor with cosine sim <0.3 — must flag low-confidence transfer.
